description: This file defines the Tax model class within the Opencart platform, specifically handling the calculation of tax totals. It contains a method to compute and add tax amounts to the order totals, and references external system components such as configuration, tax rate name retrieval, and the core model engine.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Model class responsible for calculating and adding tax totals to the order summary.
